name: Mordred
source:
A flashy knight that specializes in dual-wielding swords. He always has a ready smile and an ear for others, but he is also occasionally prone to provocative outbursts.

He acts as though he is indulging the heroine from the very start, but sometimes his demeanor comes across as artificial. He can be very difficult to get a read on.

"Rest assured, I won't expect you to wake up tomorrow loving me?"

[From in-game profile]
